raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose
This PR only changes `.buildkite/test-amd.yaml`. There, `(MI250) Spec Decode Speculators + MTP` and `(MI300) Spec Decode Speculators + MTP` run identical commands (`v1/e2e/spec_decode/speculators/` and `v1/e2e/spec_decode/mtp/`).

It replaces both jobs with a single `(MI355 DPX) Spec Decode Speculators + MTP` job with the same commands, source file dependencies, and timeout.
